$comment: Pins the interactive Second Brain agent model (config/litellm.yaml only controls routed sub-tasks; override per-session with `claude --model`). additionalDirectories grants the agent access to the Obsidian vault, which lives outside this repo. The PreToolUse hook enforces per-agent RBAC on vault writes (backstop for the .claude/agents/<id>.md allowlists + docs/vault-schema.md); it defers for unknown/unenforced roles and for non-vault paths.
